outcome: Reproductive performance (corpora lutea, implantation sites, resorptions, live foetuses)
cohort: Pregnant Sprague-Dawley rats were assigned to control, vehicle control, or treatment groups.
finding: The combination of Lumacaftor and Ivacaftor at doses equivalent to MRHD, 5MRHD, 8MRHD, and 10MRHD did not induce significant teratogenic effects in Sprague-Dawley rats.
followup_time: Up to postmortem examination of foetuses at the end of gestation
gest_age: Treatment administered from gestation days 6 to 17, with foetal analysis performed at the end of gestation.
